Name: Tall Wood Storage Cabinet w/ Oak Doors (36" W)
Natural: Diversified's Tall Wood Storage Cabinet with Oak Doors is made from solid hardwood and oak, so it's sure to withstand years of heavy use in your classroom. This sturdy cabinet has a chemical-resistant finish, so it's a perfect choice for science labs. Keep projects and learning aids on the four adjustable and two fixed shelves inside. The three-point latches on the solid wood doors protect your valuables from theft or vandalism.
